Published

Aug 02, 2026 at 05:00 AM EDT

Khaleda Rahman

National Correspondent

President Donald Trump’s approval rating is underwater in at least 11 states that he carried by double digits in the 2024 election, a sign of growing dissatisfaction with the president’s performance ahead of November’s midterms even in places where support for him is strongest.
